coordinate_assumption: world XYZ = (glTF X, -glTF Z, glTF Y); equal coordinate frame assumed

calibration.provenance: User-selected model endpoints applied. Horizontal along-scan distances use an explicit endpoint interpolation ratio; vertical station spacing and vertical scan distances stay in metres. World Z is constant along horizontal lines. Field survey/CRS accuracy is not established by model picks.

mesh_alignment.method: Area-weighted triangle normal; horizontal tangent is normal cross world Z

anchor_proposal.method: Guide only: horizontal mesh-tangent ray at the NOF_R_0157 centroid height; first equipment boundary hit is the end; measured length is traced backwards for the start. Same world Z at both ends. No field anchor or equipment clearance is asserted.
